defs.def: to give sb food or drink, for example at a restaurant or during a meal （给某人）提供；端上

ex.s: She believes she is here to serve.
ex.t: 与学长们的竞争。

ex.s: Not only does this cafe serve up drinks, it also serves up smiles.
ex.t: 这家咖啡馆不仅提供饮品，还提供微笑。

ex.s: Nevertheless, it serves as a reminder that there are many ways to address problems of sustainability, and that you can make an amazing meal out of almost anything.
ex.t: 不过，它提醒我们，解决可持续性问题的办法有很多，而且你几乎可以用任何东西做出美味的饭菜。

ex.s: The 105-year-old sequoia tree serves as a local landmark, not only for its longevity but also because renowned naturalist and Sierra Club cofounder John Muir provided the original seedling.
ex.t: 105年的沙柯亚树是当地的地标，不仅因为它的长寿，而且因为著名的自然学家和塞拉俱乐部联合创始人约翰·缪尔提供了原始的幼苗。

ex.s: It was served cold and came with some sort of sticky sauce which tasted bitter and smelt really fishy!
ex.t: 它是冷着的，配了一种黏糊糊的酱汁，尝起来发苦，闻起来鱼腥味极重！

ex.s: Examples in argumentative essays can serve several purposes.
ex.t: 论证性散文中的例子可以达到几个目的。

ex.s: Traditional accompaniments such as Yorkshire pudding, sausages, stuffing and gravy are also served.
ex.t: 还提供传统的配菜，如约克郡布丁、香肠、填料和肉汁。

defs.def: to be enough for sb/sth 食物的量

ex.s: 38   This is often appreciated since at a housewarming there isn’t a lot of food served.
ex.t: 38   这通常受人欢迎，因为暖房派对上供应的食物不多。

ex.s: There's a new frontier in 3D printing that's beginning to come into focus： food． Recent development has made possible machines that print， cook， and serve foods on a mass scale． And the industry isn't stopping there．
ex.t: 3D打印出现了一个新的前沿领域，正开始受到关注：食品。近期的发展使能够大规模打印、烹饪并供应食物的机器成为可能。而该行业并未止步于此。

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

defs.def: to help a customer or sell them sth in a shop/store 接待；服务

ex.s: The parent — who was me, by the way — just got served.
ex.t: 父母——顺便说一句，就是我——刚刚得到服务。

ex.s: Additionally, it could serve a larger audience such as a hospital, restaurant or school.
ex.t: 此外，它也可以服务更大的群体，比如医院、餐厅或学校。

defs.def: to be useful to sb in achieving or satisfying sth 对 … 有用；能满足 … 的需要

ex.s: The popularization of emotional intelligence has helped both the public and researchers re-evaluate the functionality of emotions and how they serve people adaptively in everyday life.
ex.t: 情商的普及帮助公众和研究者重新评价情绪的功能，以及它们如何在日常生活中适应性地服务于人们。

ex.s: The hospital is very old and can no longer serve the needs of the town.
ex.t: 这家医院已经很老了，不能再满足小镇的需求了。

ex.s: Dutch plantsman and designer Piet Oudolf’s gardens popularized this style, adding artistic flavors to the planting mixes while playing with color and form, including four-season interest and serving the needs of wildlife.
ex.t: 荷兰园艺师兼设计师 Piet Oudolf 的花园推广了这种风格，在色彩和形态上做文章，增添了艺术气息，兼顾四季趣味并满足野生动物的需求。

defs.def: to provide an area or a group of people with a product or service （向一地或一群体）供应，提供

ex.s: It also serves a variety of chef’s specials, beef with rice cakes, and more.
ex.t: 它还供应各种主厨特色菜、年糕炒牛肉等。

ex.s: It serves only dinner.
ex.t: 它只供应晚餐。

ex.s: Serving hard-to-find Thai dishes in an elegant atmosphere, the restaurant is true to Thai cuisine’s roots, yet still manages to add a special twist.
ex.t: 餐厅在优雅的氛围中供应难觅的泰式菜肴，既忠于泰菜的本源，又巧妙增添了特别的变化。

ex.s: For two weeks in March, Greenwich Village’s Blue Hill restaurant was renamed wastED, and served items like fried skate cartilage, a juice pulp burger, and a dumpster diver’s vegetable salad.
ex.t: 三月的头两周，格林尼治村的蓝山餐厅改名为wastED，供应诸如炸鳐鱼软骨、果汁渣汉堡和垃圾箱潜水者蔬菜沙拉之类的菜品。

ex.s: It serves hard-to-find local dishes.
ex.t: 它供应难得一见的当地菜肴。

ex.s: Much still needed to be done before dinner was served, but already outside the building many homeless people were gathering.
ex.t: 晚餐供应之前还有很多事情要做，但建筑物外面已经聚集了许多无家可归的人。

ex.s: It wasn’t until a couple of hours later that we opened the doors and began serving dinner.
ex.t: 直到几个小时后，我们才打开门，开始供应晚餐。

defs.def: to be suitable for a particular use, especially when nothing else is available 可用作，可当 … 使（尤指别无选择时）

ex.s: To serve its function, a book must be activated by a user: the cover opened, the pages parted, the contents reviewed, perhaps notes written down or words underlined.
ex.t: 为了发挥其功能，一本书必须由使用者来激活：打开封面，翻开书页，浏览内容，也许还要写下笔记或划出字句。

ex.s: Today, on an island in the Pacific, a specific type of shell still serves as currency — and some people there are even hoarding it, just like Bitcoin moguls, convinced that one day, it will make them wealthy beyond imagination.
ex.t: 今天，在太平洋的一个岛屿上，一种特定的贝壳仍然作为货币使用——有些人甚至囤积它，就像比特币模具一样，相信有一天，它将使他们变得富有，超越想象。

ex.s: So while some of the world's first coins were made from a naturally occurring hybrid of gold and silver called electrum, objects other than coins have served as currency, including beads, ivory, livestock, and cowrie shells.
ex.t: 因此，尽管世界上最早的一些硬币是由黄金和白银的天然混合物——金银合金制成的，但除硬币外的其他物品也曾被用作货币，包括珠子、象牙、牲畜和贝壳。

defs.def: to have a particular effect or result 产生 … 的效果（或结果）

ex.s: For example, stress could serve as a cue that one responds to by eating, which produces the reward﹣the reduction of stress.
ex.t: 例如，压力可以作为一个线索，人们以进食来回应它，从而产生奖赏——压力的减轻。

ex.s: I managed to get an A in that   53  and learned life lessons that have served me well beyond the  54  .
ex.t: 我设法在那门___53___拿了A，学到的生活道理在我毕业后也一直受用。

defs.def: to work or perform duties for a person, an organization, a country, etc. （为 … ）工作，服务，履行义务，尽职责

ex.s: Emotional intelligence, with its focus or both head and heart, may serve to point us in the right direction.
ex.t: 情商兼顾头脑与内心，或许能为我们指明正确的方向。

ex.s: I thought that we would just be passing out dinners to those in need, but I found out we would be doing everything from preparing to serving the dinner.
ex.t: 我以为我们只是分发晚餐给那些需要帮助的人，但我发现我们要做的事情从准备到服务晚餐无所不包。

ex.s: Sometimes she arrives early to serve the students early.
ex.t: 有时她早到为学生服务。

ex.s: “In a Go game each move should serve a long-term goal.
ex.t: “在一盘围棋中，每一步都应为长远目标服务。

ex.s: I studied abroad and later moved away from my parents’ home to look for  51  Through years of  52 , have become respected teacher in school serving high-need students.
ex.t: 我在国外学习，后来离开父母家去寻找____51____，经过多年____52____，已成为一所服务高需求学生的学校里受人尊敬的老师。

ex.s: Today Pacific Science Center serves more than 1.3 million people a year and beings inquiry-based science education to classrooms and community events all over Washington State.
ex.t: 今天，太平洋科学中心每年为130多万人提供服务，为华盛顿州各地的教室和社区活动提供以调查为基础的科学教育。

ex.s: When the eggs were hatched, the baby birds made the similar chirp to their mothers—a sound that served as their regular ＂feed me!＂ call.
ex.t: 蛋孵化后，幼鸟会发出与母亲相似的声音——一种作为它们常规“喂我！”叫声的声音。

ex.s: The most hopeful data shared in the report shows clear evidence of parents serving as examples and important guides for their kids when it comes to reading.
ex.t: 报告中分享的最有希望的数据表明，有明确证据表明，在阅读方面，父母为子女树立了榜样和重要的指南。

ex.s: She has served here for 17 years and can’t imagine working anywhere else.
ex.t: 她在这里工作17年了，无法想象去别的地方工作。

ex.s: His not-for-profit organization runs 100 river boats that serve as floating libraries, schools, and health clinics, and are equipped with solar panels and other communicating facilities.
ex.t: 他的非营利组织运营着100艘河船，这些船作为流动图书馆、学校和诊所运营，并配备太阳能板和其他通讯设施。

defs.def: to spend a period of time in a particular job or training for a job 任期为；担任（职务）时间达；培训期为

ex.s: Wang serves as head of the Architecture Department at the China Academy of Art (CAA).
ex.t: 王担任中国美术学院（CAA）建筑系主任。

ex.s: Serve as guides on a farm.
ex.t: 在农场担任向导。

ex.s: As I served the role of vital communication link, I was reminded of my desperate struggle to converse before I learned English.
ex.t: 当我担任重要的沟通桥梁角色时，我想起了自己在学会英语之前拼命试图交流的痛苦挣扎。

defs.def: to spend a period of time in prison 服（刑）

ex.s: As I watched him take off his basketball uniform and replace it with a baseball uniform, I saw him leaving behind the layer that no longer served him, just as our lizard had.
ex.t: 当我看他脱下篮球服、换上棒球服时，我看到他丢下了那层不再适合他的外壳，就像我们的蜥蜴一样。

defs.def: to give or send sb an official document, especially one that orders them to appear in court 把 … 送达；向（某人）送交

ex.s: The team’s data only went up to 2007, but the researchers also explored what would happen if consumers replaced old products with new electronics that serve more than one function, such as a tablet for word processing and TV viewing.
ex.t: 团队的数据只统计到2007年，但研究人员还探讨了如果消费者用具有多种功能的新电子产品替代旧产品会发生什么，例如用于文字处理和看电视的平板电脑。

defs.def: to start playing by throwing the ball into the air and hitting it 网球等
to continue doing sth, especially working or staying in prison, for a fixed period of time that has been set 干至期满；服满刑期
to share food or drink between a number of people 分发（食物或饮料）；（为众人）分餐
to put food onto plates and give it to people 端上（食物）

ex.s: When the food is served, you should wait until you're invited to eat.
ex.t: 当食物端上来时，你应该等到被邀请时才吃。

defs.def: to give, offer or provide sth 给出；提供

chunks.en: serve dinner / needs / foods / cold / people / variety / purposes
chunks.cn: 供应晚餐 / 满足需要 / 提供食物 / 冷着上菜 / 为人们服务 / 提供多样 / 达到目的
